Pull up your chair, shuffle the deck, and get ready — Lesbians Playing Uno is BACK 🃏✨

This ain't your grandma's card night. It's cards, cocktails, and straight-up chaos hosted by Jayme Davis. Someone's gonna throw a +4 out of spite. Someone's gonna flip the table (lovingly). Everyone's gonna have the time of their life.

Low stakes. High energy. Zero pressure to actually be good at Uno — we just want the vibes and the laughs. Grab your crew, grab a drink, and come claim your spot at the table before it fills up. This is the Latinx hangout you didn't know you needed every second Sunday. 💛💙❤️💚

🗓️ Sunday, November 8th — 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free Entry
#AzucarPasco #OutAndAbout #LesbiansPlayingUno #UnoNight #PascoNightlife #LatinxNightlife #FreeEntry #CommunityNight

Picture this: cards slapping the table, ice clinking in your glass, laughter so loud it drowns out the music 🎶🃏

That's Lesbians Playing Uno. The lights are low, the drinks are flowing, and the energy is pure chaos in the best way. Jayme's hosting, the room's buzzing, and every round feels like a plot twist waiting to happen. Draw two? Draw four? Reverse? Somebody's about to lose it (lovingly).

It's the kind of night that sneaks up on you — you came for Uno, you stayed for the vibes, the people, and the drinks that kept coming. Come feel it for yourself. 💫

🗓️ Sunday, November 8th — 8PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Free Entry

Come as you are, cards or no card skills required 🫶🃏

Lesbians Playing Uno is more than a game night — it's a space to show up exactly how you are, surrounded by community that gets it. Hosted by Jayme Davis, this is low stakes, high energy, and zero judgment if you can't remember the rules (we won't either, honestly). 

Meet new friends, catch up with old ones, and let the cards do the talking. Everyone's welcome at this table — bring your people, bring your favorite drink order, and settle in for a night built on good company and better chaos. This is what Sunday nights were made for. 💛

Grab your friends, grab a seat, and get ready for a night of friendly competition that definitely won't stay friendly for long. 😏
